experiment_description: Measure the temperature dependence of the longitudinal resistivity in a magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene device (MATBG1, twist angle 1.05 degrees) at a filling factor of 1.7 to determine the linear slope of the temperature-dependent resistivity.

drho_dT_slope.description: The linear slope of resistivity with respect to temperature in Ohms per Kelvin.

experiment_description: Subject a magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene device to continuous-wave 0.14 THz radiation while maintaining the lattice temperature at 2 K. Measure the relative THz-induced photoresistance (change in resistivity normalized to the dark resistivity) at its peak magnitude.

max_relative_photoresistance_percentage.description: The maximum observed relative THz photoresistance expressed as a percentage.

experiment_description: Measure the THz-induced change in resistivity of a doped monolayer graphene (MLG) control device under 0.14 THz irradiation while keeping the lattice temperature at 2 K and applying zero external magnetic field.

zero_field_photoresistance_response.description: The qualitative magnitude of the photoresistance response observed at zero magnetic field.

experiment_description: Measure the longitudinal resistivity as a function of temperature for a twisted bilayer graphene device with a twist angle of 1.58 degrees in the low-temperature regime, specifically at fillings where umklapp scattering is forbidden, to extract the experimental prefactor of the quadratic temperature dependence.

T2_resistivity_prefactor.description: The measured prefactor for the quadratic temperature dependence of resistivity in Ohms per Kelvin squared.
